_template.status: TEMPLATE: not a release spec. v2.release.build refuses this schema on purpose; copy it, set schema to dev2-release-spec/1 and replace every PLACEHOLDER value before any build.
_template.fill_after: a Milestone 3 finalist passes the ~27B release gate (post-key v3 >= 64.9, human transfer not significantly below AutoJev-27B, no decision type collapsed) and the coordinator records a release decision
_template.checkpoint: the finalist's qwen-adapter checkpoint (a v2.27b.lora_soup output with soup_manifest.json, or one seed's BEST); expected_identity.model_sha256 = checkpoint_fingerprint(checkpoint, base.path)
_template.calibration: the adopted CAL698 report from v2.release.calibrate_frozen --source-path --require-kernels --max-length 32768 (inference.max_length must equal max_input_tokens), or null when v2.release.dev_calibration rejected it (then say T = 1 and give the rejected temperatures in card.calibration_text)
_template.release_sh: run release.sh with --base-path set to base.path, --require-kernels, --site /opt/decision-fla, --env TRITON_CACHE_AUTOTUNING=1 and --env TRITON_CACHE_DIR=<copy of the formal run's post-run frozen autotune cache> mounted with --mount-rw, and --parity for every scored panel
_template.frozen_autotune_cache: PLACEHOLDER: path and tree hash of the formal run's post-run Triton autotune cache (the one a release run must reuse)

base.redistribution: not redistributed: the package pins the base by repository revision and per-file SHA-256, and it is fetched or supplied at load time

calibration.path: PLACEHOLDER: adopted CAL698 calibration.json (or set calibration to null for T = 1)

origin.summary: PLACEHOLDER: a PEFT LoRA adapter (rank, alpha, every text projection) and a native candidate head trained on the frozen Qwen3.8-27B text backbone at `1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0` (Apache-2.0), which is not redistributed; say whether the release is a uniform seed soup.

runtime_requirements.triton: PLACEHOLDER: version of the image's triton (persisted autotune cache)

runtime_equivalence: PLACEHOLDER: how decision2/qwen.py (adapter profile, pinned base, BF16 backbone / FP32 head, adopted calibration or T = 1) matches the scored kernel-path execution, and the release.sh --parity checks run with the frozen autotune cache.

scored.label: PLACEHOLDER: post-key same-panel run <formal run id> (kernel path, frozen autotune cache, 32,768-token limit)
